messages:
Evelyn Park: quick sync — proposing a compact "canary governor" design: fuse signals, apply hysteresis, then execute a two‑phase rollback. keep it lightweight for Hosted/Dedicated/Private.
Jonas Meyer: what signals? p95, 5xx rate, session drop, and optional model-quality. each gets a weight.
Tara Singh: weights ok but need rule: (weighted_score > threshold AND (hard_fail OR sustained_window)). also require min-samples to avoid jitter.
Evelyn Park: governor emits a `candidate_rollback` event with confidence and tenant-impact metadata. human review only for high-impact tenants.
SRE Bot: note: tenant-impact includes qps, active sessions, SLA tier. enterprise tenants default to extra guard rails.
Jonas Meyer: actuator API: PREPARE -> COMMIT. PREPARE validates target exists and capacity; COMMIT returns commit_id for reconciliation.
Tara Singh: reconciliation: if router doesn't report commit_id within T seconds, mark failed, retry once, then page.
OpsAlice: partition decisions per-tenant; elect leader for multi-region tenants to avoid split-brain. store small cooldown TTL per-tenant in KV.
Evelyn Park: cooldown/backoff: initial hold = 2 windows; cool-down = max(30s, severity*window); exponential backoff on repeats.
Jonas Meyer: observability: each decision event must carry inputs (metric snapshots), rule version, commit_id, actor (auto/manual), pre/post routes. immutable for postmortem.
Tara Singh: testing: e2e sim with noisy network for many tenants; target false-positive < 0.5% and MTTR to safe rollback < target.
deploy-bot: canary-governor sim deployed to staging :white_check_mark:
Evelyn Park: action items: Jonas+Tara draft rule DSL and actuator contract; OpsAlice spec RBAC; I'll prototype Console explain UI. two-week spike.
